_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics (5% breakout rate) and absent institutional bid make HOLD the disciplined default—Disbelief is the adjacent rung the market would enter if sentiment recovers, but there is no confirmed breaker to justify a directional bet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split—analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction; narrative leans toward a bottom-turn thesis without committing to a directional call, creating an implicit directional disagreement the judge resolves toward the analyst's coil logic.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows break above 20 with stablecoin growth rising above 45, signaling institutional return plus liquidity expansion for a genuine Denial-to-Disbelief transition
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed drops below 20 with funding below 35 and 30-day momentum falling below 40, matching true capitulation mechanics and pushing toward Panic/Anxiety
